question: What obligation of disclosure is fulfilled by telling this practice of the soul to the one addressed?
premises: The practice of the soul is the subject.
It has been told to the one addressed.
The address is directed to Bhairavī.
inference: This practice of the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.
uncertainties: No further details of the practice are given in this verse.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
